entries.note: NOTED for TODO 95 (price the carry spot leg — basis risk): a funding trilemma for perp-style mechanics — basis-only funding loses relative force near a boundary, while uniform relative-basis correction requires unbounded transfers and conflicts with payer solvency/participation. A structural statement about the basis leg's failure modes: the honest-marked book prices the basis that actually printed, but the mechanism itself can go slack at the boundary — one more reason the basis leg is risk, not yield
